title: Semantic Grammar artifact
description: Machine digest of the K'UHUL semantic EBNF (data/grammar/kuhul.runtime-grammar.ebnf): the §24 XCFE node-class closed set with its atom→rung routing, §24 operators, §25 GlyphOps (SC-13 table), §26 gram channel vocabulary, §3 phase_ref rung order, and the §73 attributed lexical grounding (@cue/@morpheme). Emitted by tools/semantic_grammar.py — the §71 'target pipeline' compiler pass — and consumed by src/kuhul/semantic_grammar.cpp. A checker must never manufacture the authority it verifies: a missing source is reported, never reverse-engineered from the artifact.

rungs.description: C6 rung order, compiled from §3 phase_ref (Pop→Wo→Yax→Sek→Ch'en→Xul).

routings.description: Atom → rung, compiled from §24 xcfe_node_class including its (* -> rung *) routing comments. This is the §72 licensing ladder as data: the ladder's atom admission table.

glyph_ops.description: §25 glyph_op: the closed set of KLSL GlyphOps admissible at Sek (SC-13).

gram_channels.description: §26 gram_channel_name fixed vocabulary (the production additionally admits arbitrary string channels).

cues.description: §73 attributed lexical grounding: surface cue → node class. Cue resolution grounds atoms; it never authorizes (SC-24).

morphemes.description: §73 morpheme rules: affix-scoped grounding. Emitted pseudo-cues (prefix:un / suffix:able) must exist in the cue table; min_stem is the minimum stem length after stripping the affix (prefixes 3, suffixes 2 — the historical grounding-lane guards).

transpiles.description: §71 @transpile attributed productions: surfaces → (key, b, theta, gram). theta must be a declared rung; b a binary address. Empty until real productions are authored in the EBNF (the §71 example remains commented); the compiler validates them as soon as they are authored.

verification_algebra.VERIFIED: shape valid, source present, regeneration matches the generated subset
verification_algebra.INVALID: schema violation, or a declared source is missing, or regeneration disagrees
verification_algebra.UNVERIFIED: no canonical source available; absence of proof is representable and is neither PASS nor FAIL
